title: TripLOG — five itinerary export concepts followed by five expense export concepts
request: 사용자 수정 요청: 종류를 섞지 않고 일정 버전 5개를 먼저, 지출 버전 5개를 그다음에 생성
status: All ten concept images generated and displayed; no application implementation or deployment
selectionOrder: This new set: itinerary 1–5 first, followed by expense 1–5. Numbers are bound to visible generation order within each group. The earlier mixed set is separate.
composition: Each concept pairs mobile export UI (390 × 844) with an A4 portrait PDF concept on a 1440 × 1080 canvas
sharedDesignBrief: TripLOG design: white, dark navy #0b1020, yellow #fff05a actions, sky #bce6fb, pink #f7afc7, fine outlines, small hand-drawn destination illustrations, readable Pretendard-style Korean. Use 15–16px mobile body text and generous print typography. Header information left, illustration right. Current date 2026-10-12. Fictional trip “순천의 사흘”, 2026.10.09–10.11, two travelers.
itinerarySample: Keep the same itinerary: DAY 1 10:30 순천역, 11:00 국가정원, 18:00 숙소; DAY 2 09:30 낙안읍성, 12:30 카페, 16:00 순천만; DAY 3 09:30 중앙시장, 11:30 죽도봉, 14:00 순천역.
